        try {
            Fiber::suspend("pause58");
        } catch (Exception $caught) {
            echo "GEN-CAUGHT", (int)($caught === $given),
                 (int)($caught->getPrevious() === null),
                 (int)($caught->getMessage() === "given58"), "|";
        } finally {
            echo "GEN-FINALLY", (int)($this === $weak->get()), "|";
        }
        yield "after58";
        echo "GEN-END|";
        return 71;
    }
}
function RunMethodReceiver58() {
    global $generator, $weak;
    echo "CALL|";
    try {
        $result = $generator->current();
        echo "CURRENT", (int)($result === "after58"),
             (int)($weak->get() !== null), "|";
        return "fiber58";
    } finally {
        echo "CALL-FINALLY", (int)($weak->get() !== null), "|";
    }
}
$given = new Exception("given58");
$receiver = new FiberMethodReceiver58();
$weak = WeakReference::create($receiver);
$generator = $receiver->generate();
unset($receiver);

    $reply = $fiber->throw($given);
    echo "REPLY", (int)($reply === null), "|";
} catch (Exception $caught) {
    $failed = true;
    echo "CALLER-CAUGHT", (int)($caught === $given),
         (int)($caught->getPrevious() === null),
         (int)($caught->getMessage() === "given58"), "|";
}
echo "FIBER", (int)$fiber->isTerminated(), (int)$fiber->isSuspended(), "|";
if (!$failed) {
    echo "FRETURN", (int)($fiber->getReturn() === "fiber58"), "|";
}
echo "LIVE", (int)($weak->get() !== null), "|";
if ($generator->valid()) {
    $generator->next();
    echo "GRETURN", (int)($generator->getReturn() === 71), "|";
}
echo "CLOSED", (int)!$generator->valid(), (int)($weak->get() === null), "|";
unset($generator, $fiber);
echo "DROPPED", (int)($weak->get() === null), "|";
